ui.aboutIntro: What it is, which plugins it lists, and what automatic detection means.
ui.faqWhatA: A directory of DeepSeek Harness plugins on npm, refreshed daily. Plugins are not reviewed and are published by their authors; check what a plugin does and only install ones you trust.
ui.faqVsDiscover: How is it different from DSH's Discover page?
ui.faqVsDiscoverA: It lists more plugins, lets you browse by category, popularity and release date, and shows automatic detection. Its directory is also a standard index, readable from Discover without this plugin.
ui.faqHowInstall: How do I install a plugin?
ui.faqHowInstallA: Press Install on a plugin page: DSH's own install dialog opens, and nothing installs until you confirm. You can also enter "name@version" under Add plugin on the Plugins page; with "Keep only Startide" on, enter it at the top of the Installed page instead.
ui.compatibleOnly: Hide plugins that do not support this DSH
ui.detectionNote: Found by scanning the source automatically; it can be wrong and is not a security review.
ui.notScanned: This version has not been checked yet; it will be in one of the next updates.
ui.installedHint: You can enable, disable or uninstall it under Installed.
ui.faqWhatListedA: Every package that is a DSH plugin, has a source repository or homepage, supports the current DSH and released a version in the last 90 days. Others drop out automatically and come back when they qualify.
ui.faqHowOftenA: Daily: new plugins are found, versions and downloads refreshed, and new versions checked automatically.
ui.faqDetectWhatA: A program downloads the package and scans its source for signs that it may use the network, touch files, run commands, register agent tools or carry install scripts. It reads, never runs.
ui.faqDetectWrongA: Not always. It looks at code patterns, so it can miss things or flag harmless code. It is not a security review; it only gives you an idea of what a plugin does.
ui.faqReport: Found a problem with a plugin?
ui.faqReportA: Open an issue on GitHub with the package name and what is wrong.
ui.detectionOpaque: This package ships prebuilt or minified code that detection cannot look into, so "no" does not mean none.
ui.scanFailed: This version could not be checked (too large or unreadable); the next version will be tried again.
ui.legacyInstalled: The old store ({name}) is still installed. This version replaces it; you can uninstall it under Installed.
ui.installedIntro: Update, enable, disable and uninstall the plugins you have.
ui.removeBody: What it provides will go away.
ui.notNpm: Not installed from npm; updates cannot be checked
ui.keepOnlyHint: When on, the sidebar shows only Startide and the Plugins page hides its own heading and tabs. Turn it off to restore them.
ui.bundlesFailed: Could not read the installed plugins
ui.faqManage: How do I update, disable or uninstall plugins?
ui.faqManageA: On the Installed page. Plugins with a newer version come first; confirm Update and Startide installs the new version directly, taking effect after a DSH restart. Enable and disable switch at once; uninstalling asks first.
ui.faqKeepOnlyA: It is the switch in the top right corner of the Installed page, off by default. When on, the sidebar shows only Startide, the Plugins page hides its own heading and tabs, and whenever DSH shows its own plugin list the page switches back to Startide; tabs other plugins add to the Plugins page are hidden too. Turn it off to restore everything. The setting is kept on this computer only.
ui.updateHint: Startide installs the new version directly. With hot reload on in DSH, it uninstalls the old version first and then installs the new one, as DSH itself advises; if the new version will not install, the old one goes back.
ui.updatedRestart: v{version} installed; takes effect after restarting DSH
ui.updateNeedsBuilds: The new version runs install scripts ({names}) that must be approved in DSH's install dialog: uninstall it, then install the new version from the Plugins page.
ui.removeNeedsStop: The plugin is running and DSH will not remove it: turn its switch off, restart DSH, then uninstall.
ui.updateRestored: The new version did not install; v{version} is back. Reason: {reason}
ui.updateLost: The old version was uninstalled, and neither version would install again; reinstall it from the Plugins page. Reason: {reason}
ui.updateLeftDisabled: The plugin is now disabled; turn it back on with its switch.
ui.updateUnknown: Could not tell what is installed now; check the Plugins page. Reason: {reason}
